dialogues.speaker: Lazareva
dialogues.text: *sigh* Drinking by myself... Ah, such a lonesome affair.

dialogues.speaker: Lazareva
dialogues.text: Uh... Ah, sorry. I know you mean well, but I... get uneasy when someone comes to strike up a conversation.

dialogues.speaker: Lazareva
dialogues.text: *sigh* I didn't really mean to sit alone... but if someone were to sit in front of me, I'd... Ohh, I'd surely flee the scene...

dialogues.speaker: Lazareva
dialogues.text: If only there were some way I could...

dialogues.speaker: Lazareva
dialogues.text: Ah... I see, I see... That seems good. Thank you so much...

dialogues.speaker: Lazareva
dialogues.text: I don't know how I might repay you, but... Hmm. I don't know if this would count as a reward, but earlier, I heard a Snegovik say...

dialogues.speaker: Lazareva
dialogues.text: "In the next room, the three paintings in the bedroom... conceal... a secret chamber..."

dialogues.speaker: Lazareva
dialogues.text: I think that must be the room that the Snegurochka named Aglaya left unoccupied on purpose... Hmph. This mansion is full of strange secrets, it would seem...

dialogues.speaker: Lazareva
dialogues.text: "In the next room, the three paintings in the bedroom... conceal... a secret chamber..."

dialogues.speaker: Lazareva
dialogues.text: I wonder what that means, exactly...
